name: N-ethylhexylone
summary: N-Ethylhexylone is a recreational designer drug from the substituted cathinone family, with stimulant effects. It was first identified in Poland in August 2019. It is illegal in Taiwan since July 2020, where it had been sold mixed with plant material under the name ("Rainbow Tobacco" or "Rainbow Smoke").
